name: kgteach
description: CLI and MCP tool that lets AI agents analyze Go games with KataGo and explain key mistakes from SGF files.

interface.shortDescription: KataGo SGF review for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Use kgteach when an AI agent needs KataGo evidence for Go, baduk, or weiqi review. It inspects SGF files, compares candidate moves, validates variations, creates quizzes, and returns rank-aware teaching payloads through a stable JSON contract.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this SGF and find teachable moments.
